profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer at Facebook working in Developer Infrastructure. We build tools to help other developers be more productive. I've worked on Buck – Facebook's open source build tool; folly – Facebook's open source C++ library, and other projects.

As a graduate research assistant at The University of Texas at Austin, I worked on computer systems and security.  In particular, many of my past projects have looked at how we can modify existing operating systems to introduce new security guarantees to the applications or users running on top of the system.  My current work is focused on modifying the virtualization stack of the Linux operating system to provide user application better isolation from malicious applications and a potentially hostile OS.

https://github.com/mzlee
http://stackoverflow.com/users/639849/michael

positions.description: Led the New Mexico team in the pilot DHS secure design competition.  This resulted in a publication about our experience at CSIIRW.

positions.title: Engineering Intern

positions.title: Instructor's Aide
positions.description: I prepared and lead discussion sections for EECS 281, Data Structures and Algorithms.  I additionally helped write homework problems and exam problems.

positions.title: SDET
positions.description: I helped test some of the backend logic for Windows Live's data collection pipeline.  I also created a test framework for other groups to use when implementing and using the data collection pipeline.

positions.description: Teaching Aide for EECS 281 - Data Structures and Algorithms.  Taught a discussion and held regular office hours.

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: I helped create and deploy social networking applications that interacted with Zattoo status information.  Additionally, I helped create and manage the payment system and administrative view.

positions.title: Helpdesk Technician
positions.description: I helped students debug housing networking issues and staff with networking and software issues.

positions.title: Head Programmer
positions.description: As head programmer for www.campusshoutouts.com, it was my job to create the backend code.  I created most of the site from scratch using PHP, Javascript, HTML, and CSS.

projects.title: Anon-Pass
projects.description: Anon-Pass is a cryptographic protocol and system which allows companies to provide anonymous authentication without users ever having to expose their private password.  However, companies are guaranteed that a user's credential cannot be used to log in more than once at a single time.

publications.title: Anon-Pass: Practical Anonymous Subscriptions
publications.publisher: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy · May 1, 2013
